meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：Subject + verb + as + adjective / adverb + as possible + other information。

rules.zh: 這個句型表示：在實際情況容許下，把某種程度提高或降低至極限。 盡可能清楚 盡可能安靜 盡可能小心 它不一定表示事情必須達到絕對完美，而是表示在當時情況下，應盡力做到最高程度。
rules.en: The structure expresses the highest practical degree ● as clear as possible ● as quiet as possible ● as carefully as possible It does not necessarily mean that something must be absolutely perfect. It means that the person should do the best that is reasonably possible under the circumstances.
examples: The structure expresses the highest practical degree
as clear as possible
as quiet as possible
as carefully as possible
It does not necessarily mean that something must be absolutely perfect. It means that the
person should do the best that is reasonably possible under the circumstances.

rules.zh: 在這個句型中，形容詞或副詞應使用原形，不使用比較級或最高級。
rules.en: Use the basic form of the adjective or adverb Correct: ● as quickly as possible ● as simple as possible ● as carefully as possible Incorrect: ● as more quickly as possible ● as simplest as possible ● as most carefully as possible
examples: Use the basic form of the adjective or adverb
Correct: as quickly as possible
as simple as possible
as carefully as possible
Incorrect: as more quickly as possible
as simplest as possible
as most carefully as possible

rules.zh: 形容詞通常描述人或事物的狀態： 副詞通常描述動作進行的方式：
rules.en: Choose an adjective or adverb according to its function. An adjective normally describes the state of a person or thing: Keep the message as short as possible. Make the road as safe as possible. An adverb normally describes how an action is performed: Write as clearly as possible. Drive as carefully as possible.
examples: Choose an adjective or adverb according to its
Keep the message as short as possible.
Make the road as safe as possible.
Write as clearly as possible.
Drive as carefully as possible.

rules.zh: 表示某件事應在最早可行的時間開始或發生，重點是不要延誤。 （請盡快聯絡我。） 表示某個動作應以最高可行速度完成，重點是動作的速度。 （請盡快完成表格。）
rules.en: “As soon as possible” and “as quickly as possible” are different. As soon as possible means that something should begin or happen at the earliest feasible time, with the focus on avoiding delay: Please contact me as soon as possible. As quickly as possible means that an action should be completed at the highest feasible speed, with the focus on how fast it is done: Please complete the form as quickly as possible.
examples: “As soon as possible” and “as quickly as possible” are
As soon as possible
Please contact me as soon as possible.
As quickly as possible
Please complete the form as quickly as possible.

rules.zh: As soon as possible 是這個句型中最常見的固定說法之一，常用於日常對話、電郵、工作指示 和緊急通知。 在較非正式的工作溝通中，有時會縮寫為 ASAP；不過，在正式寫作中使用完整說法通常較有禮 貌。
rules.en: “As soon as possible” is one of the most common fixed expressions in this pattern. It is common in conversation, email, workplace instructions and urgent notices. It is sometimes shortened to ASAP in informal workplace communication, although the complete expression is usually more polite in formal writing.
examples: “As soon as possible” is the most common fixed
expression in this pattern
It is also commonly shortened to ASAP in informal workplace communication, although the
complete expression is usually more polite in formal writing.

rules.zh: 兩句意思十分接近，但本練習要求把其他說法改寫成：
rules.en: “As … as you can” has a similar meaning ● Speak as clearly as you can. ● Speak as clearly as possible. as + adjective/adverb + as possible
examples: “As … as you can” has a similar meaning
Speak as clearly as you can.
Speak as clearly as possible.
as + adjective/adverb + as possible

benefits.zh: 這個句型能準確表示你不只是希望事情「很」清楚、安全或快速，而是希望在實際情況容許下做到 最高程度。
benefits.en: It expresses the required degree precisely This structure makes it clear that you do not merely want something to be “very” clear, safe or quick. You want the highest practical degree that the situation allows.

benefits.zh: 例如 Please reply as soon as possible 能清楚表達事情緊急，同時保持中性和有禮貌的語氣。
benefits.en: It makes instructions clear without sounding unnecessarily harsh Sentences such as “Please reply as soon as possible” communicate urgency clearly while remaining neutral and polite.

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以把「在你能做到的最早時間」等較長說法縮短，使句子更加直接。
benefits.en: It shortens longer explanations Instead of saying: Please send the document at the earliest time you can. You can say: Please send the document as soon as possible.

benefits.zh: 你可以用它表達時間、速度、安全程度、大小、成本、清晰程度、距離和難度等不同概念。
benefits.en: It is useful in many situations You can use it when talking about time, speed, safety, size, cost, clarity, distance, difficulty and many other qualities.

benefits.zh: 掌握 as ___ as possible 這個框架後，你可以直接加入不同形容詞或副詞，有助你在說話時更快 組織句子。
benefits.en: It provides a ready-made speaking frame Once you know the frame as ___ as possible, you can insert different adjectives and adverbs without planning the whole sentence from the beginning.
